messages:
alex: Afternoon — planning a mid-window deploy at 14:00 PT for slot 18 (small config toggle + one migration). Owner: alex. Quick checklist below, pls ack.

maya: Ack from me. what's the expected downtime for the migration?

alex: Migration is online-DDL (small schema add) — no downtime. Max extra p95 latency ~40ms for writes.

chris: I'll be primary smoke owner. I'll run prod-smoke and watch tail of gateway logs. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.infra/smoke/slot18

sam: Rollback plan: flip feature flag, run migration rollback script if needed. Rollback command:
```
./ops/db_migrate rollback --id=20260317_18 --env=prod
```
Also have last-known-good snapshot at s3://gc/redwood/snapshots/slot18/20260317

irene: Are we gating via canary? How long at 1% before bump?

alex: Canary 1% for 10m, then 10% for 5m, then full. If any error rate spike >0.8% or p50 latency >300ms, abort and rollback.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy slot 18 at 2026-03-17T21:00:00Z — CI green, auto-checks passed.

maya: :thumbsup: I'm good for the 1% window. Will monitor writes for migration anomalies.

chris: :eyes: I'll watch gateway svc and model runtime metrics. alert channel: #incidents

sam: Confirmed rollback owner: sam. I have runbook open and I am reachable on +1-555-0102.

alex: final preflight: config flags set in prod-config repo? @maya @irene

maya: flags are in prod-config PR: https://git.redwood/prod-config/pull/462 — I approved.

irene: gating flag is sticky and can be toggled instantly via admin panel if needed.

alex: ok, last call — drop an ack if you are holding steady. Then I'll kick at T-0.

maya: ack

chris: ack

sam: ack

alex: kicking canary in 5m. will post updates.
